title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1973-06-10
lineage: transferred by Matt Smith; MAC tapes > Nak BX300 > Apogee Mini Me > Mini DAC (monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > 24/96 FLACs > Samplitude Pro 7.22 > TLH > CD Tag
source: Source: taped and remastered by Monte Barry; Sony TC 2850SD portable stereo cassette recorder Sony ECM 99 single-point stereo mic is hand-held on mic-stand shaft, with arm raised up FOB center infield, between sbd platform and stage platform;

ai_review.summary: A nicely‑sounding audience tape that captures a tight June ’73 show with standout Morning Dew, an epic Birdsong jam and a third‑set featuring Trucks, Saunders & Betts (and a Dark Star).
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as one of the better AUD sources, with Charlie’s transfer delivering clear enough sound to enjoy the band’s tight playing. Fans highlight the first‑set magic of Morning Dew and Playin’ In The Band, a marathon Birdsong jam, and an unforgettable third set that shines thanks to guest appearances (Trucks, Saunders & Betts) and a soaring Dark Star. Overall the performance is described as “on” and emotionally powerful despite the inherent limitations of audience recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers are enthusiastic, citing several standout songs and a strong performance; recording quality is noted as good but not perfect, leading to a solid above‑average combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as one of the nicest sounding AUDs and a decent capture; clear enough for enjoyment with a well‑done Charlie transfer, though some ambient loss of tightness compared to soundboard recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds to a thrilling Playin' In The Band ending with fireworks, the second set maintains momentum, and the third set steals the night with guest‑filled jams and a soaring Dark Star.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as being "on" and finally breaking out, delivering stellar leads in Birdsong and Dark Star.
